name: Smart-home devices
description: Smart-home devices for Home 3D: sensors, switches, thermostats, doorbells, boilers, meters, alarms, smart speakers and radiators, modelled from simple shapes so they can be linked to their Home Assistant entities. Ships with the app and works offline.
release_note: Release 4: the pack's id is now amluto.devices (it was theovencook.devices); plans that name the old id still load (#424).
